assumptions.constantCd: Inferred within the declared coefficient bounds, not a measured universal coefficient curve.
assumptions.effectiveB: s^-1 combined Magnus parameter, not measured angular speed or rpm.
assumptions.noise: Independent isotropic Gaussian coordinate error; sigma adjustable and not provided by the problem.
assumptions.wind: Given scenario; not jointly identified from two frames.
assumptions.regions: Empirical perturbation regions are initially uncalibrated. Virtual test coverage does not establish real-world coverage.
assumptions.failureAccounting: Keep all attempted trials, including fit/domain/ground/no-plane events.
assumptions.sliders: Exploration ranges, not FIFA qualification ranges or experimental confidence intervals.

limits: Only first-flight ball-center plane crossing; no collisions or bounce.
The two-time inverse problem cannot freely identify every environmental parameter.
Paper-scale independent experiments remain user-controlled and are not claimed completed by software QA.
